messages:
Maya (CEO): thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. quick follow-up on hiring and org changes 1: we approved the new FY26 headcount envelope and a small reorg in Platform. filing the brief decisions doc here: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/fy26-decision-summary :wave:

Rina (People Ops): posting the intake form + timeline. managers can start drafting reqs today. note: final comp bands will land next week; recruiters will hold openings until bands are posted.

Liam - Eng: quick Q 1: will the Platform reorg involve moving any headcount between Eng infra and Eng runtime? want to know if we should expect shifted managers/headcounts.

Maya (CEO): short answer: no net headcount moves between Eng infra and runtime. were reallocating scope and creating a new director-level role to own platform integrations. existing teams keep their headcounts for now.

Joan - PM: does this change roadmap commitments for Q1? any features deprioritized because of the shift?

Maya (CEO): roadmap stays broadly intact. some low-priority refactors will be bumped to Q2 to free up cycles for Dedicated performance work. product will publish an updated roadmap next Wed.

Omar S: regarding approvals 1: what's the sequence? budget approval vs comp band signoff vs recruiter assignment?

Rina (People Ops): sequence: 1) intake submitted + manager drafts req, 2) budget greenlight (we have it), 3) comp band assigned (target next Tue), 4) recruiter is assigned and role is opened. recruiters may prep passive outreach earlier.

Liam - Eng: internal mobility policy? we have two senior ICs interested in moving into Product Eng. how should managers flag that?

Rina (People Ops): internal first. add candidates to intake and mark "internal_candidate":true in the notes. recruiting will run parallel external searches but internal candidates are prioritized for interviews.

Joan - PM: can we get guidance on interview panels? want to avoid overloading small teams with repeated interviews.

Rina (People Ops): recommended panel = hiring manager + 2 cross-functional interviewers (product/sre/infra depending on role). interview duration capped at 75 mins by default. for small teams we can rotate interviewer pools.

Omar S: will the reorg change oncall responsibilities or escalation chains?

Maya (CEO): no immediate changes to oncall policy. the new director will consolidate escalation for platform integrations but day-to-day oncall stays with existing squads. any changes will be announced with 30d notice.

Liam - Eng: curious about naming conventions for reqs that relate to the Platform reorg so reporting is easier.

Rina (People Ops): use prefix PLAT- for roles tied to the reorg, e.g., PLAT-integrations-eng-2. this helps reporting and budget tracking.

Recruiting Bot: Reminder: intake form -> https://redwood.example.com/hr/intake (auto-post)

Joan - PM: thanks 1: can we get a one-pager on what constitutes "high priority" hires vs "steady-state" so PMs and Eng managers align?

Maya (CEO): yes. Rina will circulate a priority rubric and weekly review cadence. leadership will triage requests during the weekly hiring sync.

Liam - Eng: last q 1: for Dedicated infra hires, any restriction on remote-first vs onsite? our candidates are mostly remote in EMEA.

Rina (People Ops): no blanket restriction. certain roles require proximity to data centers or US-based customers; those will be flagged. otherwise remote-first is allowed, subject to manager approval and time-zone considerations.

Maya (CEO): appreciate the great Qs. i'll be monitoring this thread for the next hour. if you need deeper follow-ups let's book quick huddles. :thumbsup:
